outline: Fluid mechanics delves into the static and dynamic behavior of fluid motion. This course covers fundamental properties and principal concepts of fluids, such as pressure distribution, and conservation laws for mass, momentum, and energy. Applications involving internal and external flow will also be given. This course equips students with the ability to analyze and design fluid systems based on appropriate theoretical model.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to fluid mechanics
Week 2: Fluid Properties
Week 3: Fluid Statics I: conversation of mass and momentum
Week 4: Fluid Statics II: energy transport
Week 5: Kinematics of Fluid Flow
Week 6: Conservation of Mass
Week 7: Conservation of Momentum
Week 8: Conservation of Energy
Week 9: Midterm exam
Week 10: Dimensional Analysis
Week 11: Similarity & Boundary Layer
Week 12: Viscous Flow Fundamentals
Week 13: Laminar Flow in Pipes
Week 14: Turbulent Flow in Pipes
Week 15: Head Losses in Pipe Systems
Week 16: Pipe Flow Systems
Week 17: Unsteady Flow & Water Hammer
Week 18: Final exam
